originalTitle: 'Parents are offering to pay kids' wages': Salon owner
summary: National Insurance (NI) paid by firms on under-25s should be gradually lowered to help create more jobs, according to a new report from former government minister Alan Milburn, due to be published on Tuesday.
content: National Insurance (NI) paid by firms on under-25s should be gradually lowered to help create more jobs, according to a new report from former government minister Alan Milburn, due to be published on Tuesday.
chineseTitle: “父母愿意支付孩子的工资”：沙龙老板
chineseSummary: 前政府部长艾伦·米尔本 (Alan Milburn) 将于周二发布的一份新报告称，应逐步降低企业为 25 岁以下年轻人支付的国民保险 (NI)，以帮助创造更多就业机会。
